$comment: Read by scripts/harvest.mjs and scripts/build.mjs. `include` is a regex on ontologyDbId; only matching ontologies are harvested and published. Display names are the upstream ontologyName with `stripWords` removed (whole words, case-insensitive), unless `names` overrides them by id. The original name is kept in additionalInfo.sourceOntologyName.

knownBroken.CO_356: cropontology.org returns HTTP 500 for /brapi/v2/variables?ontologyDbId=CO_356 (and v1) at any page size, though every variable loads on its own via ?observationVariableDbId=. Likely cause: 9 scales (37 variables) have categories stored as dates by Excel, e.g. '1-2-3' became 2003-01-02T00:00:00. No other ontology has non-text categories. Found 2026-11-18.
